query: Which single primary outcome (lost-time injury rate vs standardized productivity index) best balances clinical relevance and statistical power for a cluster trial in ageing workforces?

response.query: Which single primary outcome (lost-time injury rate vs standardized productivity index) best balances clinical relevance and statistical power for a cluster trial in ageing workforces?
response.answer: The lost-time injury rate best balances clinical relevance and statistical power for a cluster trial in ageing workforces. It directly measures workplace safety and health impacts. It is statistically robust for detecting significant changes.
